scope_of_deliverables.value: The British Columbia Energy Regulator (BCER) is seeking a vendor to develop a modular, maintainable download solution to replace the existing Oracle APEX-based CSV download functionality. The new solution will integrate with TIBCO Data Virtualization (TDV) web services to retrieve datasets in JSON and XML formats and allow dynamic export into structured formats like CSV and Excel. The scope includes reviewing the existing Oracle APEX functionality, designing a lightweight front-end component, developing backend transformation logic, testing and validating downloads, aligning with BCER’s standards, packaging for deployment, and providing knowledge transfer and documentation. This is detailed under the 'Scope of Services' section on page 7.
scope_of_deliverables.quote: The selected Proponent will work with BCER’s Digital Services and Data Platform teams to design and implement a replacement for the existing Oracle APEX-based CSV download functionality. The new solution will integrate with TIBCO Data Virtualization (TDV) web services to retrieve datasets in JSON and XML formats and allow dynamic export into structured formats like CSV and Excel. The scope includes: Review of the existing Oracle APEX download functionality and its dependencies; Design of a lightweight, secure front-end component or widget to initiate downloads from TDV endpoints; Development of backend transformation logic (if needed) to convert JSON/XML into CSV/Excel; Testing and validation of download accuracy, field mapping, and data formatting; Alignment with BCER’s accessibility, performance, and security standards; Packaging the solution for deployment and integration with the current BCER website infrastructure; Providing knowledge transfer and documentation for BCER staff.

The 'Mandatory Criteria' section on page 9 lists submission and procedural requirements, not technical capabilities of the solution. No section explicitly defines technical requirements for the solution itself.

No numeric scoring formula is provided; pricing is judged qualitatively based on these factors.
